messages:
Sara (eng): Heads-up — planning to cut RC at 17:00 PT today. Need a quick roll-call: version bump, changelog, docs, QA smoke. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4821
MattC: I can do the version bump and tag. I'll push `git tag -a v0.23.2 -m "v0.23.2"` after merges. ETA 16:30 PT.
KevinT: Changelog PR is queued, just needs one more approve and a short blurb for Optimize changes. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4823
Olga: Docs: I'll update the release notes + migration guide. Will drop a follow-up PR by 16:45 PT. @Sara (eng) do we need a note about the batching config change?
Sara (eng): Yes please add a short bullet about default batching/kv-cache behavior change — one line is fine. Also call out any breaking config keys.
Jess: Security review quick check — dependency scan is clean, dependency bump CVE noted but mitigated. I'll add the security sign-off comment on the changelog PR.
qa-bot: Preflight checks: unit tests OK, integration smoke failing on redis-connection flakiness (2/10). See logs: https://ci.redwood-inference/run/9876
MattC: I'll rerun smoke after tag. If redis flake persists, can we flip the retry back to 3s for this RC?
Sara (eng): OK do one rerun. If still flaky, include a known-issue note and schedule a hotfix. We can't delay cutoff past 17:00. @Olga @Jess please confirm doc + sec sign-off by 16:55 PT. :thumbsup:
Olga: Confirmed — docs PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/329, summary added.
Jess: Confirmed — security sign-off posted on changelog PR.
release-bot: Preflight completed at 16:58 PT — all required checks green except transient redis smoke. Manual rerun requested by MattC.
MattC: Rerun done, smoke now 8/10, acceptable for RC with known flake note. Tagging and cutting RC now: `git tag v0.23.2 && git push origin v0.23.2`
Sara (eng): Thanks everyone — rolling canary per usual. I'll open the rollout task and ping on the incident channel if anything spikes.
